title: IBM watsonx.data 2.4.0 through 2.4.0 patch 8 could allow a remote attacker to obtain sensitive… (CVE-2026-14885)
description: IBM watsonx.data versions 2.4.0 through 2.4.0 patch 8 contain an improper access control vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information. The vulnerability is identified as CVE-2026-14885 and has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 4.8. No public exploits or known active exploitation have been reported. No patch or remediation details are currently provided.
